build_MagicGraspAction: build a MagicGraspAction to snap the robot gripper to the nearest scene object or marker within threshold distance
build_SuctionGraspAction: build a SuctionGraspAction to grasp objects by detecting physics contact points between gripper links and scene objects
build_GazeGraspAction: build a GazeGraspAction to grasp objects centered in the camera frame within a configurable distance and cone angle range
refactor_GripSimulatorTaskAction: refactor the GripSimulatorTaskAction base class to customize the requires_action property for new articulated agent actions
review_GazeGraspAction_determine_center_: review the GazeGraspAction _determine_center_object method to understand how panoptic segmentation identifies graspable objects in the camera center
